name: Bayesian cable curl
cue: Keep your elbow pinned behind you and curl from the elbow only.
research: research.json biomech.bayesian_curl: right arm, facing away from a pulley at hand height (v10), left foot forward. The lean 5 -> 12 deg is a small hip hinge (pelvis flex +7 with both thighs +7 relative to the pelvis, so the planted legs keep their world pose: front hip 20 -> 27, rear hip -9 -> -2). Rear knee straightened to 0 (research 5) so both soles sit level on the plate; front knee 15. Upper arm 35 -> 30 deg behind the trunk with 7 deg abduction (research 5; the extra 2 deg moves the hand and D-handle out past the hip at mid-range), elbow 10 -> 127 around a still elbow (research 135; 127 is inside the tolerance and keeps the biceps belly from bunching edge-on into the elbow crease at the peak, and keeps the forearm away from lining up with the cable, a listed mistake), supinated grip, free hand on the hip. The D-handle rides on a hidden hinge through the circumcentre of the FK grip at start, mid and end (via key M carries the exact mid angle; tools/design/bayesian_curl.mjs), so the IK only corrects millimetres. Its D-shaped loop (straight sides clear of the fist, then converging) ends 0.05 H behind the grip to the clip; the loop swings about the bar (dof dloop, set at A, M and B) so it always points at the pulley, as a free-swinging D-handle does. Its steel frame is 12.5 mm thick (0.0035 H), as on a real D-handle: on the figure v2 body the fuller rear thigh met a 16 mm frame mid-lowering (0.0043 H deep between the verify frames); now the deepest graze is 0.0033 H. Cable column 0.69 H (1.23 m) behind the stance centre and outboard of the working side. v10 (science audit A7): the pulley rides on a carriage on the column at hand height (0.47 H; the audit's "about 0.45 H", the cue's "cable at hand height"), in a fork 7 cm in front of the uprights and above the weight stack's travel; the stack hangs 0.02 H above a stop on the base plate at the stretch (2:1, 0.0015 H per degree), so it never touches down. The cable leaves the D-handle 5 deg below horizontal at the stretch and stands close to square to the hanging forearm: moment 0.84 of maximum at elbow 10 (v9's low pulley: 0.25, the cable 49 deg below horizontal), 0.31 at the peak, so the biceps is loaded at long length (Androulakis-Korakakis 2024). Geometry: tools/design/bayesian_curl_v10.mjs (v9: tools/design/bayesian_curl.mjs).

camera.note: Research view az 70 / el 5: the front of the working arm faces the camera. At the stretch the biceps reads as a long stripe down the front of the arm behind the hip, at the peak as an oval in the V between upper arm and forearm. Fill 0.65 (the cap) because the biceps is small at phone size. fitMachine false: fitting the column 1.23 m behind the lifter shrank the figure, so the column may crop at the left edge; the cable still shows where the load comes from.
